title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-07-31
lineage: transferred by Matt Smith, mastered by Monte Barry. MAC tapes > Nak BX300 > Apogee Mini Me > Mini DAC (monitoring/mastering) > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > 24/96 FLACs > Samplitude Pro 7.22 > TLH > CD Tag
source: taped by Monte Barry, Nakamichi 550 portable stereo cassette recorder, taped with Dolby NR on Maxell UD C90 normal bias cassettes, Sony ECM-99 single-point stereo mic, mic is mounted on a 12-foot pole, FOB.

ai_review.summary: Clear, well‑separated audience recording of a concise 1973 set with professional performances despite shorter‑than‑usual jams.
ai_review.review: The tape offers superior clarity and instrument separation compared to other sources, making it an excellent primary reference even though some portions of the concert are missing. Musically the band delivers solid, professional versions, but most tracks stay under ten minutes, which is atypical for this era. Overall the show is enjoyable, though its brevity and incomplete coverage temper enthusiasm.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is decent but unremarkable (short jams), while recording quality is praised as clear and detailed; limited number of reviews leads to medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear separation and clarity, nice sounding overall; however the source is missing a significant portion of the concert ('meat') making it incomplete.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusually concise set with most songs under ten minutes, still professional and enjoyable despite lack of extended jams.
